searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords matched against organization names, e.g. food bank, animal rescue, youth education.

states.title: States (optional)
states.description: Two-letter US state codes to filter by, e.g. TX, CA, NY. Empty = all states.

minRevenue.title: Min annual revenue (optional)
minRevenue.description: Only return organizations whose latest reported total revenue is at least this (USD). Requires financials.

maxRevenue.title: Max annual revenue (optional)
maxRevenue.description: Only return organizations whose latest reported total revenue is at most this (USD).

includeFinancials.title: Fetch IRS 990 financials per organization
includeFinancials.description: Adds latest revenue, expenses, assets, and a multi-year revenue trend (one extra request per organization). Organizations with no filing data become free rows.

maxOrgs.title: Max organizations per run
maxOrgs.description: Cap on organization rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip organizations seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned EINs across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled prospecting.
